raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Replaces the NCCL checkpoint engine's Ray collective group and CuPy master buffers with a dedicated PyTorch `ProcessGroupNCCL` backed by `TCPStore`. This lets the engine use the NCCL-compatible communication backend exposed through PyTorch on special accelerator devices where CuPy does not expose NCCL, while preserving the existing rank topology, metadata transport, and bucket protocol.

This does not duplicate an existing PR. Open PR searches for [ProcessGroupNCCL checkpoint engine](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+ProcessGroupNCCL+checkpoint+engine), [NCCLCheckpointEngine PyTorch](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+NCCLCheckpointEngine+PyTorch), and [Ray collective checkpoint engine](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+%22Ray+collective%22+checkpoint) found no overlapping change.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Queries are linked above.
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

- `PYTHONPATH=/tmp/nccl-bootstrap:. /private/tmp/verl-recovery-pr-venv/bin/pytest -q tests/checkpoint_engine/test_nccl_process_group_on_cpu.py` — 3 passed.
- Selected-file pre-commit passed: Ruff, Ruff format, mypy, trainer config generation, documentation checks, license, device API usage, test structure, naming, and Python compilation.
- Unit tests cover broadcast completion through the dedicated process group, `TCPStore`/`ProcessGroupNCCL` initialization and barrier, consumer metadata connection, and process-group abort during rebuild cleanup.
- A multi-rank accelerator integration test was not run locally; the PR remains a draft pending upstream CI and backend validation.

### API and Usage Example

No consumer API changes. Existing configurations continue to select `checkpoint_engine.backend=nccl`; the engine now creates and owns its PyTorch NCCL process group internally.

### Design & Code Changes

- Allocate both sender and receiver buckets as CUDA `torch.Tensor` objects.
- Publish a separate `TCPStore` port with the existing ZeroMQ metadata endpoint.
- Construct a dedicated `ProcessGroupNCCL`, bind it to the actor's visible device, and wait for broadcast and barrier work handles.
- Abort and clear the owned process group when `rebuild_group` is enabled.
- Remove this engine from the CuPy dependency rationale; NIXL, delta-sharded, and Megatron still require CuPy.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply pre-commit checks to every changed file.
- [ ] Add / Update documentation. No user-facing configuration or API changes are introduced.
- [x] Add focused unit tests for process-group lifecycle and broadcast behavior.
- [ ] Request upstream CI and backend validation before marking the PR ready for review.
- [ ] The human submitter has reviewed every changed line and can defend the change end-to-end.
- [x] AI assistance was used to extract, implement, test, and draft this change (OpenAI Codex). The commit includes a `Co-authored-by` trailer.

 # Pins cupy once for the fsdp / megatron parents. Two unrelated consumers, both

-# every disaggregated weight-sync engine (nccl / nixl / delta_sharded) imports
-# it; and Megatron MoE all-to-all uses it directly. Without it the engine module
-# fails to import and the backend never reaches CheckpointEngineRegistry.
+# the nixl and delta_sharded weight-sync engines import it; Megatron MoE
+# all-to-all also uses it directly. Without it those engine modules fail to
+# import and their backends never reach CheckpointEngineRegistry.
 cupy-cu130 = ["cupy-cuda13x==14.0.1"]
 
 # ---- inference backends ----------------------------------------------------

+
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from verl.checkpoint_engine.nccl_checkpoint_engine import (
+    BroadcastOperation,
+    MasterMetadata,
+    NCCLCheckpointEngine,
+)
+
+
+def test_broadcast_operation_uses_dedicated_process_group():
+    operation = BroadcastOperation.__new__(BroadcastOperation)
+    operation.rank = 0
+    operation.process_group = MagicMock()
+    operation.bucket = MagicMock()
+    operation.metadata = {"length": 1}
+    operation.socket = MagicMock()
+    operation.topic = "metadata"
+
+    operation._run()
+
+    operation.process_group.broadcast.assert_called_once_with(operation.bucket, 0)
+    operation.process_group.broadcast.return_value.wait.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+def test_init_process_group_builds_torch_nccl_group(monkeypatch):
+    engine = NCCLCheckpointEngine.__new__(NCCLCheckpointEngine)
+    engine.rebuild_group = False
+    engine.process_group = None
+    engine.is_master = False
+    engine.rank = None
+    engine.world_size = None
+    engine._connect_zmq_client = MagicMock()
+    store = MagicMock()
+    process_group = MagicMock()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("verl.checkpoint_engine.nccl_checkpoint_engine.torch.distributed.TCPStore", store)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "verl.checkpoint_engine.nccl_checkpoint_engine.torch.distributed.ProcessGroupNCCL",
+        process_group,
+        raising=False,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr("verl.checkpoint_engine.nccl_checkpoint_engine.torch.cuda.current_device", lambda: 0)
+    metadata = MasterMetadata(zmq_ip="127.0.0.1", zmq_port=1234, store_port=2345, multi_sender=False)
+
+    engine.init_process_group(rank=1, world_size=2, master_metadata=metadata, num_senders=1)
+
+    store.assert_called_once()
+    assert store.call_args.args[:4] == ("127.0.0.1", 2345, 2, False)
+    process_group.assert_called_once_with(store.return_value, 1, 2, store.call_args.args[4])
+    process_group.return_value.eager_connect_single_device.assert_called_once()
+    process_group.return_value.barrier.return_value.wait.assert_called_once_with()
+    engine._connect_zmq_client.assert_called_once_with(metadata)
+
+
+def test_finalize_aborts_rebuilt_process_group(monkeypatch):
+    engine = NCCLCheckpointEngine.__new__(NCCLCheckpointEngine)
+    engine.rebuild_group = True
+    engine.rank = 0
+    engine.world_size = 2
+    engine.process_group = MagicMock()
+    process_group = engine.process_group
+    engine.store = MagicMock()
+    engine.send_buf = MagicMock()
+    engine.recv_buf = MagicMock()
+    empty_cache = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr("verl.checkpoint_engine.nccl_checkpoint_engine.torch.cuda.empty_cache", empty_cache)
+
+    engine.finalize()
+
+    process_group.abort.assert_called_once_with()
+    assert engine.process_group is None
+    assert engine.store is None
+    assert engine.rank is None
+    assert engine.world_size is None
+    assert engine.send_buf is None
+    assert engine.recv_buf is None
+    empty_cache.assert_called_once_with()
